Elena — great news, congratulations on the sign.

I've attached a first-cut "SynergeMed-MAP-v1.2.xlsx" that embeds the implementation ops manifest, canary scope, and training windows. Key highlights up front:

- Target MVP canary: 3 clinics (your pilot set) over a 2-week observation window.
- Canary traffic ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over three controlled steps (48-72h each) with automated metrics gating.
- Evaluation plan: daily quality checks (ROUGE/semantic drift sampling), latency p95 targets, and endpoint error-rate thresholds.
- Migration approach: sidecar routing + prefix KV caching to preserve steady-state latency. No DB migration required for MVP.
- Training: three 90-minute sessions (admin, trainers, clinicians) + recorded playbacks. Calendar invite attached.
- Ownership: I've assigned primary leads in the sheet (Redwood: Grace/Marissa/Jonas; SynergeMed: Elena + Eng lead).

Next steps:
1) Review the MAP and comment by Thursday EOD so we can finalize for your CTO on Friday.
2) Jonas will propose a canary simulation (internal dry-run) — details below.
3) Marissa will share support SLAs and on-call roster for the cutover window.

I'm copying Marissa and Jonas to confirm internal capacity for a Jan 18 canary start.

Best,
Grace O'Connor

Elena — attaching the finalized MAP and the canary scope diagram per our notes. This version incorporates the internal simulation, explicit rollback criteria, and the training schedule. TL;DR below, full details in attachments.

TL;DR
- Canary start: Monday, 2027-01-18 (Week 1 ramp 5% -> 20%); Week 2 ramp 50% -> 100% for pilot clinics if gates pass.
- Gates: daily quality sample pass rate >= 90% (semantic acceptance), endpoint p95 latency <= 350ms, error rate < 0.5%. Any two consecutive gate failures trigger automated rollback to pre-canary routing.
- Evaluation: 7-day lookback for quality regressions; independent sample set supplied by SynergeMed (we'll ingest via secure S3 link).
- Training: three live sessions the week before cutover (Jan 10–14), recordings shared immediately.
- Operational rehearsal: internal canary simulation run on 2026-12-22; we'll share readout and playbook.

Attachments: SynergeMed-MAP-v1.2.xlsx, canary-scope-diagram.pdf, training-schedule.ics

Best regards,
